messages:
alex: noticed a burst of tiny GPU pods Pending in us-west2 this morning after the warmpool resize. pods hang ~40-70s then often get evicted. anyone else seeing this?

jamie: same. quick trace: node becomes Ready but gpu labels arrive ~35s later; scheduler prebind fails with missing labels.

scheduler-bot: alert: 9 pending pods >30s on warmpool-usw2 (metric: scheduler.prebind.latency)

maria: paste of node init log from one repro node:
```
Apr 20 02:10:11 cloud-agent: instance provisioned
Apr 20 02:10:13 kubelet: initial registration
Apr 20 02:10:14 kube-prober: saw NodeReady
Apr 20 02:10:50 label-sync: applied gpu-count=2,gpu-type=rtx (duration=36s)
Apr 20 02:10:51 kubelet: NodeReady (full)
Apr 20 02:10:52 scheduler: PreBind failed: node labels missing
```

ops: this is a label-arrival ordering race between cloud-provider readiness and our label agent. scheduler assumes Ready -> labels present, but not always true after the warmpool image change.

jamie: short-term: enable a scheduler-side label-wait when bind fails for tiny/gpu pods (poll up to 30s), and canary bump prebind timeout for tiny-class to 75s in us-west2.

maria: scheduler-side snippet idea:
```
if bindError == MissingNodeLabels and pod.requests.gpus > 0 and node.annotation == "warmpool":
  for i in 0..6:
    if nodeHasLabels(node):
      retryBind()
      break
    sleep(5s)
```

ops: agree on conservative scope: only warmpool nodes and tiny-class to limit migration/egress risk. we'll canary 5% first.

oncall: i've started canary cny-4329 (us-west2 tiny-class 5%). watching metrics: scheduler.label_waits.{attempts,succeeded,failed}, pending_p95, eviction_rate, migration_egress. will alert on >10% egress increase.

alex: thanks. small cost note: last time this pattern hit, cross-AZ migration egress spiked ~90GB/hr for short-lived tiny jobs. don't make global timeouts without perf numbers.

jamie: agreed. long-term fix: reorder node-init so label-sync runs before signalling Ready, or make label agent idempotent and quicker. i'll open an RFC for init-order change after canary results.

maria: PR created for scheduler label-wait + metrics (https://go/redux/pull/9123). canary dashboard: https://go/redux/dashboards/warmpool-label-wait?env=us-west2

ops: rolling to 50% if canary stable after 30m. oncall, continue monitoring for 2h and escalate if pending_count rebounds.

oncall: ack, monitoring now and will notify if regressions.
